subject: Qualification: PoC/Trial Plan & Deployment Mode — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecorp.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification: PoC/Trial Plan & Deployment Mode — Acme Corp

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we keep momentum on the PoC discussion: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference into Acme's customer support triage to reduce time-to-first-response by 30% while keeping false positives under 2%.
- Users: Support platform team + 2 ML engineers + Security lead.
- Data sensitivity: Some PII, must support SOC2-level controls; may need Private (VPC/on-prem) for regulated flows.
- Throughput target: ~20 requests/sec average with 500 concurrent sessions during peak.

Deployment modes discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to start, managed keys, best for quick iteration.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and isolation.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for highest data controls / compliance.

Immediate ask / next step:
1) Can you confirm which of the three deployment modes you want us to prioritize for the PoC? If unsure, tell us which flows require the highest controls.
2) Please confirm success criteria for the PoC (e.g. latency < 300ms p50, accuracy / fallback thresholds, cost target).
3) Who are the stakeholders we should include in a 30–45 minute runbook / kickoff next week?

I'll loop in Marissa (SE) to draft a short PoC plan and timeline once we have the above.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification: PoC/Trial Plan & Deployment Mode — Acme Corp

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the summary and call. Quick answers below: 

1) Deployment mode: For initial PoC we prefer Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU) for the latency guarantees and isolation; however, some flows that touch payment data will require Private VPC (we can scope those out of the first sprint).

2) Success criteria (PoC):
- Latency: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 700ms (on our test dataset)
- Throughput: sustain 20 req/s for 15 minutes without error spikes
- Quality: intent classification F1 > 0.88 (on our sample prompts)
- Security: encryption in transit + at rest, and audit logs for 30 days

3) Stakeholders to include:
- Tom Reed (Infrastructure / Procurement)
- Priya N. (Security) — I'll loop her on the next thread
- ML Lead: Daniel Park (cc me if you want)

We'll need a recommended timeline and estimate for Dedicated capacity pricing. Please share a short PoC plan and the list of artifacts you need from our side.

Best,
Alice
Director, Support Automation | Acme Corp
alice.zhang@acmecorp.com

Hi Alice / Ben —

Following up with a concise PoC/trial plan based on the success criteria Alice shared. Attached is a short PoC deck and a checklist (acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf). High level:

Scope: 
- Phase 0 (Prep, 1 week): share test prompts, sample traffic profile, API keys for staging, and security questionnaire answers.
- Phase 1 (PoC - Dedicated, 2 weeks): Redwood will provision Dedicated capacity matching target throughput. We'll run an ingest of your sample dataset and run benchmark tests for latency and accuracy.
- Phase 2 (Compliance check & Private path, 1 week optional): for payment-related flows, we'll deploy a Private VPC preview and confirm audit log delivery and KMS integration.

Success criteria mapped to checkpoints:
- Latency tests (bench): p50 < 250ms, p95 < 700ms (Phase 1 acceptance test)
- Throughput stability: 20 req/s sustained over 15m with error rate < 0.5%
- Quality: F1 > 0.88 on validation prompts (we'll run eval harness)
- Security: verify encryption, 30d audit logs, SOC2 artifacts provided (Phase 2)

Artifacts we need from Acme:
- 1k sample prompts + expected labels (secure upload link)
- Traffic profile (per-minute distribution)
- Contact for KMS / Network team if Phase 2 needed

Tentative timeline if we start next week:
- Kickoff: Mon Jun 7
- Phase 0: Jun 7–11
- Phase 1: Jun 14–25
- Phase 2 (if required): Jun 28–Jul 2

I've attached: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf (PoC deck), security_qs_responses.xlsx (pre-filled), and a draft SLA doc redwood-sla-draft.docx.

Questions for Acme:
- Can you confirm the date for the kickoff (Mon Jun 7 works for us)?
- Who from Security should we add to the Phase 2 planning (Priya or someone else)?

Thanks — happy to run a 30-minute kickoff to walk through the plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
